capability.summary: Apply one account group role across certified devices while preserving public signer authority and explicit execution availability.

invariants.name: A legacy leave with a committed physical leg preserves roll-forward after another leg acknowledges cancellation; owner preparation requires each original physical lifetime, acceptance state and certified proof to match as one complete witness.

Account-target owner controls retain the original signed input and complete accepted/invited lifetime witness; causal replay validates the saved parent view before append, while old delivery bincode discriminants and field shapes remain unchanged.

Executor selection prioritizes current execution readiness and operation capability over local preference; private authority arriving before its public causal state leaves the same original intent retryable and commits at most once after reconciliation.

Startup and running message-action recovery validate the saved causal view and source-sealed payload before append, persist exact recall sidecars before terminal completion, and preserve cancellation/idempotency independently of evicted target metadata.

Private explicit channel reactions retain original source/effect identity through compatible encrypted migration and bound executor certificates; views combine verified account devices, preserve causal account lifetimes through adoption, repair unambiguous legacy rows, and keep unknown authors distinct.

Original group File preparation retains one signed manifest and ciphertext through retries; actual synchronized bytes precede source execution, pending preparations pin the existing cache, and monotonic local copy completion prevents deliberate reclamation from restarting downloads.

Modern self controls bind the original account intent to its exact grant incarnation and saved causal view; valid departure retains only the original source retry route and projects Left over stale sibling membership observations.
Group access and source observations capture privacy and identity state before the event-log mutex; log-held projection never reacquires privacy, roster or host-session locks.
A verified owner account retains its owner role on owner, member and reference-only sibling devices; reachability cannot downgrade role and descriptive inventory cannot establish it.
Every group action uses account authority with current source lifetime and public signer validation; an owner account must transfer ownership before leaving on any device.

A required local recovery receipt and its source head share one durable index append; compaction retains the matching receipt, budget failure preserves the previous pair, and a complete replacement may release it.

Prepared account effects recover exact public events and sidecars, durably record the immutable source terminal outcome, then retire before later allocation; canonical control metadata refresh cannot depend on plaintext retry readiness.

Authenticated body-free sibling invalidations remain active when all optional history, attachment, appearance and contact categories are disabled; mandatory group control latency does not depend on the periodic repair tick or a held mandatory directory response. Control, directory, optional document and history/favorites work retain independent cursors and one reserved worker each within the existing four-worker and shared TCP budgets; optional document progress preserves its category and entitlement checks independently of held archive responses.

Affected canonical group access and inventory, followed by the exact durable operation result, publish before public fanout waits; canonical no-op retries allocate no invented public effect and obsolete owner authority cannot execute an awaiting control. Exact committed message IDs request durable member/relay custody in the same bounded full-control fanout round, excluding own-account siblings.

Direct or eligible-relay local admission backpressure retains the same committed fanout revision for bounded delayed retry; successful revisions deduplicate and overflow remains owned by the source journal.

Newly admitted account operations and authenticated Wake tokens can preempt a preexisting read of the same executor, retaining one bounded parked metadata checkpoint and independent foreground comparison. Validated pages alternate without combining continuation, digest, support or retry state; polling cannot rearm work, other selected executors retain priority, and accepted mutations and existing worker/TCP budgets remain unchanged.

Wake local-admission capacity failures retain their unacknowledged revision and existing ten-second retry; only a newer local publication bypasses that local cooldown, while remote failure cooldowns and sender/TCP bounds remain unchanged.

Comparison-start immutable demand and consumed authenticated Wake evidence travel with queued checkpoints, owned rollback and paired swaps. New demand starts a separate fresh comparison before an old queued suffix. A genuine follow-up can reuse a completed comparison slot while retaining the exact unfinished comparison as protected background; both-partial checkpoints, unchanged demand, refused refresh, cooldowns and full-identity cleanup preserve their existing contracts.

escalation: Require signed legacy-owner/member/reference sibling scenarios, current account binding, offline availability, transfer/revocation replay, durable pending operations and exact committed effects. Role display tests do not prove mutation authority or native cross-device convergence.

capability.summary: Share exact-ID descriptive group inventory across certified account devices without fabricating group authority.

invariants.name: Legacy groups currently held by an authorized device remain visible to its certified siblings with the owner offline; descriptive references never grant membership, keys, sending or management.
Inventory snapshots release channel state before profile lookup, and profile publication releases its store before delivery preparation
Mandatory account-directory metadata remains independent of optional personal-data switches; unsupported v4 preserves existing v1/v2/v3 domains and does not create a retry spin.

Modern memberships from a previous account remain archived for the exact local device unless the current account has a valid accepted or pending account-wide grant; legacy membership and genuine current-account departure remain distinct.

escalation: Require real legacy-owner/member/sibling private-session convergence, source-offline restart, adoption scoping, policy-off metadata-only transfer, bounded roster and no-authority assertions. Reference state must never enter authoritative group or peer binding stores.

capability.summary: Share exact-event group-copy observations between certified sender-account devices without inventing external-member delivery.

invariants.name: Versioned holder observations and negative rechecks converge independently of message history; own-account copies are excluded and missing state remains unknown. Unused recovery slots may repair reports through authenticated read-only sibling queries without replication or membership grants; logical members project signed negative-only evidence conservatively. Generic document writes cannot create custody controls.
Custody keys retain a separate bounded quota; legal document counts survive reopening, and orphan cleanup scans owned regular files once while preserving live data.

escalation: Require real linked-sibling/other-member loopback evidence, holder-offline/restart and delayed confirmation/revocation convergence. Verify old optional-domain rejection preserves supported domains.

capability.summary: Observe verified public device and account identity after the existing keystore unlocks without starting participant producers.

invariants.name: The optional synchronous identity observer runs before durable stores open, grants no runtime authority and can abort stale startup before producers launch. Existing constructors retain their behavior.

escalation: Verify blocked-store ordering, failed unlock and observer rejection, plus packaged desktop cold-start behavior.

capability.summary: Bound historical route probes and completed sync-session reuse under the shared connection budget, preserving canceled probe turns.

invariants.name: Identity-authenticated generic sync may reuse a signed accountless non-relay route only with the same full public identity and no conflicting current, historical or linked account pin; reuse never infers account membership and preserves endpoint, generation, I/O and scope checks.

Only completed reusable account sessions may retire under listener/shared pressure: one oldest-idle retirement remains pending until the owner drops real socket permits; ready frames, handshakes and active responses remain protected under unchanged eight shared/seven directional slots and the existing enclosing idle deadline.

GroupControl fresh authentication overtakes queued Ordinary work only: one active handshake per exact full identity, endpoint and privacy generation remains; FIFO within each class and an Ordinary turn after each Control prevent starvation, while cancellation and the unchanged two-second wait release all tickets.
At most two background device probes race candidates concurrently; canceled queued devices retain their next turn and healthy foreground Noise exchanges retain capacity against this producer.
Only actual outbound capacity timeouts contribute to a per-pool fixed-window bounded metadata warning; suppressed counts aggregate without sliding the next report.

Local admission backpressure preserves account-sync cursors and verified protocol support, releases bounded workers and resumes through delayed retry without exposing an authentication failure or spinning on coalesced wakes.

Completed negotiated Account sessions from SDK siblings without in-band announcements reuse only under exact full identity, current own-account presence, durable sibling certification and consistent configured proofs; generic Sync reuse never confers Account protocol authority.

escalation: Run real stalled-socket/healthy Noise capacity, rotation, cancellation and valid slow-route tests. Physical message timing remains separate from isolated contention evidence; other producers share the socket pool.

capability.summary: Synchronize typed private drafts, exact read receipts, customization assets, authenticated DM controls and account-personal conversation removal through existing certified account sessions.

invariants.name: Certified same-account authority, bounded versioned records and deletion tombstones preserve convergence without exposing private records to other group members
Optional public profiles preserve original account signatures and consent; group activity is bounded, source-signed and tied to the selected inventory without importing authority.

Personal removal persists before cleanup, binds optional Leave cleanup to its original committed operation and closed membership lifetime, and preserves Favorites, exports and other accounts' copies. Exact full-device floor acknowledgements gate historical replay; presence alone cannot restore visibility or deleted content.

Negotiated operation patches omit only exactly known nonzero role digests before page limits, complete a normal-operation prefix before loading a following legacy payload, preserve lexical continuations and full-scope authenticated atomic completion, and repair roles or operation heads changed behind a continuation on a fresh scope. Legacy-only pages retain 64 rows and existing byte, worker and deadline bounds. Operation maintenance reuses its existing processed metadata hashes before payload decoding; changed, currently unbound or unfinished foreign inputs retain verification/retry and generic input readers remain complete. A newer authenticated same-device Wake may restart only an initial remote-dial timeout for an original pending operation without a comparison pair; token identity, partial/parked cooldowns, authentication and local-capacity rules remain unchanged.

escalation: Require interrupted transfer, account replacement and old-client compatibility evidence; mocked IPC does not certify physical linked-device convergence.

For conversation removal, require keep/erase choices, pending/rejected/cancelled Leave safety, cleanup failure/restart retry, fresh invitation isolation, stale sibling history/draft/file rejection and exact-device loopback acknowledgements. Public Leave commitment alone is not private cleanup completion.

capability.summary: Distinguish unavailable sibling file copies from transfer failures without starving ordinary history, documents or later available files.

invariants.name: Typed availability requires exact certified account admission, preserves legacy wire layouts and never treats corrupt bytes or transport closure as a missing copy

escalation: Verify real loopback missing, later-available and corrupt-copy exchanges, legacy fallback and native pending-file status.

capability.summary: Repair persisted device/account bindings after authorized linking through bounded, durable, old-account/new-account/device signed transition chains.

invariants.name: Only an exact pinned full device and verified old/new account signatures authorize forward migration; replay, forks and unrelated accounts cannot rewrite existing identity
A prepared transition is not advertised until the matching adopted account is loaded; failed writes remain recoverable and security rekey does not imply continuity
Noise-bound migration proofs repair old offline recipient state without changing established account grants, history, verification or private account data disclosure

escalation: Require actual loopback Noise recipient restart and pre-link persisted-binding repair evidence; native updated-client pairing and reconnect remain required.

capability.summary: Authorize account membership and owner roles once, inherit them on certified independent devices, and revoke every sibling through one signed account grant lifetime.

invariants.name: Automatic initial migration preserves exact legacy departure lifetimes, remaining original siblings, fresh invitation incarnations and monotonic key epochs; effective permissions exclude closed initial grants while structural descendant controls and complete bounded negative proofs remain valid.
Owner-root signed controls and account-root full-device inheritance bind immutable grants, exact key tuples and causal authority; discovery and late adoption cannot manufacture membership
Accepted certified siblings inherit membership and owner roles without per-device owner approval, including with the owner offline; pending invitations receive metadata only
Account revocations merge without resurrection, reinvitation requires fresh consent, and independent sender chains exclude consumed historical keys
Capability maintenance probes only sibling or existing group relationships and never competes with an unrelated discovered DM route
Compatible legacy migration requires established verified bindings and bounded capability checks; V4 sync protects older envelopes from new control kinds

escalation: Run focused real Noise loopback inheritance with the owner offline, authority forgery/concurrency regressions, persistent V4 negotiation, frontend account member/avatar assertions and native linked-device lifecycle evidence. Mixed-version groups must defer migration safely; installed cross-platform validation remains separate.

capability.summary: Share only a frozen owner-authorized bounded text copy after invitation acceptance without exposing prior sender chains.

invariants.name: Existing channels default off; only an active owner signs policy changes, which affect future invitations
Count, authored-time, frame, expiry, recall, source authority and invitation lifetime bounds apply to separately encrypted copies and their post-acceptance row-key releases
V3 sync gates new event kinds, replay/restart deduplicates original IDs and shared copies arrive as silent history
Protected rows do not consume invitation history budgets or become ordinary snapshots, and incoming protected copies retain concealed projections

escalation: Run focused Noise loopback and restart tests, registered desktop admission tests and the history-settings browser scenario. Native cross-platform lifecycle gates and required CI remain separate acceptance evidence.

capability.summary: Persist encrypted account-owned message snapshots and notes, independently retain files, reconcile certified siblings, and export/restore the collection through portable recovery archives.

invariants.name: Protected text and images are excluded atomically from capture; retained canonical protection also blocks snapshot presentation, file reads/exports, certified-sibling exchange and portable Favorites export without changing the Favorites wire layout
Canonical source resolution and atomic grouped capture never accept caller-claimed source plaintext; ordinary retention does not erase favorites
Certified-sibling policy intersections, bounded records and deterministic revisions/tombstones prevent cross-account disclosure and stale resurrection
Favorite file access requires a nonremoved unexpired reference and never grants transfer consent
Portable recovery preserves collection metadata, notes and removal generations, withholds expired content and validates independently retained files before publication

escalation: Run the certified-sibling loopback save/edit/remove and policy/foreign-account tests; preserve old account-history wire fixtures. Native/physical device evidence is required before claiming cross-machine behavior.

Portable-format changes require recovery_snapshot, recovery_archive and recovery_key integration targets, encrypted archive Favorites roundtrip/restart tests and registered native Google Drive command coverage; old schema tags stay readable.

capability.summary: Return canonical recent search references and bounded exact context through existing history owners, preserving legacy search consumers.

invariants.name: Account, channel and legacy-device identities remain distinct; unresolved IDs are unavailable and text/time never establish exact identity

Recent search and exact context decode only selected canonical rows while preserving deduplication, pending acceptance, recovery, expiry and recall; retained metadata scans do not imply constant-cost or complete search
Exact context remains namespace-scoped, caps output at 51 canonical rows and omits recalled re-edit plaintext; missing, recalled or expired targets are unavailable
Protected text remains absent from default history, search and context; explicit exact lookup rechecks namespace, recall and expiry

Protected raster images use existing encrypted transfer while exact authorized reveals preserve policy, retention, recall and expiry; ordinary reads and exports reject them and missing manifest metadata never grants media access

escalation: Desktop adoption requires owner-isolated registered IPC, exact duplicate-result selection and bounded/unavailable old context. Core search tests alone do not certify native or UI navigation acceptance.

Both local and Google Drive recovery preserve the account, generate a new device and reencrypt supported stores without overwriting an existing local profile

capability.summary: Authenticate ordinary profiles automatically, preserve immutable system-recorded creation metadata and keep private verification independent.

invariants.name: Creation metadata is generated with the account key; unknown legacy dates stay unknown and edits cannot set or change them
Authenticated latest-per-account profiles survive restart, backup and device linking with bounded storage
Failed public profile publication and avatar clears retry without duplicate events, reconnects or blocking behind one unresponsive peer
Large signed avatars converge across child-first opaque pages while same-mailbox messages and authenticated receipts remain deliverable
Linked devices expose one signed account nickname, avatar and bio; nickname edits preserve other claims and joining local names never override adopted authority
Verified contact nicknames survive stale public card labels, presence expiry and restart without personal aliases or changing signed claims

capability.summary: Retry immutable delivery work across routed latency with bounded independent control lanes and cancellation-owned tasks.

invariants.name: Accepted channel files retain one durable event identity and their protected manifest across failed sidecar projection, lock transitions and restart; recovery never requests send authorization again
Bounded runtime observations describe only exact recipient attempts; stale or missing details never change durable delivery confirmation
Slow destinations cannot monopolize receipt or file scheduling
Participant retirement drains admitted control tasks and only authenticated recipient evidence confirms delivery
Cached addresses share one probe per device and slow authentication does not append another refresh delay
Authenticated route timing is bounded and a completed winning route can serve a verified alternate hint without weakening endpoint or identity isolation
Whole delivery exchanges adapt to route latency and independent bounded retry cooldowns preserve recovery and recipient-confirmation semantics
Signed accepted membership and per-member sharing preferences select automatic history sources while control fallback learns preference changes
Only projected group info changes emit bounded invalidations; targeted coalesced recovery and capped jittered fallback retain independent custody timing
Failed file-consent persistence defers each wrapper until the next mailbox operation without adding it to the node-wide seen cache or blocking unrelated messages
Fair bounded per-peer exchanges, mutation-safe sibling continuation and coalesced host invalidations preserve progress under partial failure.
Completed protocol-specific sessions reuse authenticated sockets; stale sockets retry once while malformed frames never trigger capability downgrade and legacy peers retain bounded fallback.
Directory freshness, recovery membership and presentation lifetimes are distinct; healthy five-second refresh waves progress beside stalled queries with eight global slots and cancellation ownership
Direct channel image bytes progress before optional relay custody without bypassing attachment consent; local previews preserve bounded original signed chunks for other members

Directory v5 and federation v3 preserve bounded source distances without extending origin expiry; legacy encodings remain unchanged and unknown distance stays unknown. Automatic relay selection reuses expiring measured costs, retains explicit healthy preferences and fairly samples fallback candidates.
Direct pinned pairing has bounded connection and response stages; only a clean authenticated response-boundary close can negotiate legacy history, while network failures preserve their cause
Removing a channel account removes all certified member devices in one signed epoch and stale automatic sibling enrollment cannot recreate membership
Sibling history wakes during active pulls retain a bounded immediate follow-up instead of waiting for periodic retry or reporting premature completion
Account enqueue captures all verified recipient and sibling bindings before immutable destination creation; sibling copies never confirm external recipient delivery

Passive certificates never replace a pinned device account; explicit recipient recovery revalidates the reviewed exact full-key old/new binding without accepting other changes or merging verification/history

Duplicate unfinished handshakes for the same full identity, candidate endpoint and privacy generation share bounded admission without retaining TCP permits while waiting; unrelated healthy sync retains progress

Healthy relay receiving keeps its own cadence while a valid slow alternative retains bounded progress; unrelated roster churn cannot cancel eligible work, current policy/network changes retire owned requests, and mailbox switches retain a dedicated receive-worker wake for prompt cancellation and resumption

escalation: Channel file acceptance and projection changes require accepted_channel_file_sidecar_failure_recovers_same_identity_and_protection and channel_file_authorization_rejects_before_staging_or_wal_acceptance, covering ordinary and protected images, pending canonical history, live recovery and restart.
Channel acceptance/custody changes require registered owner enqueue tests, exact-ID frontend reconciliation, and loopback post-office durable-wrapper confirmation evidence.

Channel media retention/completion changes also require cargo test -p mesh-talk-core --bin mesh-talk-node file_saves:: --features fast-test-kdf; library-only selection cannot exercise delayed CLI export after a non-sharing receiver prunes chunks.

Node wiring has broad shared state and dynamic consumers: retain conservative Node library coverage; crypto/wire/storage changes need loopback, restart and protocol integration evidence. Runtime/discovery lifecycle changes require focused native acceptance.

Delivery observation changes require focused observation-owner and actual worker tests, exact-account/owner isolation, stale completion and recipient confirmation precedence. Host projection also requires typed frontend consumer checks; native acceptance must exercise participant retirement and the registered IPC response.
Producer/session lock-order changes require send_authorization_never_retains_the_delivery_journal_lock plus concurrent ordinary profile publication and account/channel send evidence.
Deadline framing is a wire/storage boundary; verify legacy compatibility and affected message delivery consumers.

capability.summary: Enforce authenticated send-time deadlines on both sender and recipient copies.

invariants.name: Both directions hide expired plaintext and erase local copies without replay resurrection
Wire compatibility and recipient clock and restart protections remain intact

escalation: Public exports, features and dependency/build changes require affected package builds and public consumer compile checks; library tests alone do not prove binary, feature or platform compatibility.

CLI, integration test harnesses/fixtures and acceptance examples use conservative Node library fallback. Explicitly run the changed binary/example build and affected integration targets (including ignored multi-process CLI tests when behavior changes); these selectors do not execute those targets.

CLI data-directory ownership changes additionally require cargo test -p mesh-talk-core --features fast-test-kdf --bin mesh-talk-node tests::profile_lock and cargo test -p mesh-talk-core --test two_node_cli participant_cli_reopens_same_profile_on_requested_port_after_quit_eof_and_input_error -- --ignored --test-threads=1. Run the portable child-process lock scenarios on Linux, macOS and Windows; Node library fallback does not exercise OS locking or process restart.

capability.summary: Exclude cooperating CLI writers before opening participant or post-office stores, retaining the OS lock through the process lifetime.

invariants.name: Only one cooperating updated CLI process owns a data directory, including before PID publication
Releasing ownership preserves the lock file and actual process termination permits restart

escalation: This private cfg(test) module owns only its federation/consent fixture and assertions; shared fixture or production transport/consent changes must select their owning consumers separately.

capability.summary: Share account sign-in through private certified-device access records while preserving local encrypted storage ownership.

invariants.name: Account login envelopes preserve local UUID and distinct storage secrets; collisions, corruption and stale authorization fail without legacy credential fallback
Desktop V4 pairing requires a signed account-bound credential snapshot before key adoption; certified-sibling essential synchronization is independent of optional categories
Accountless enrollment pins a signed source and validates V4 credentials, account metadata and optional signed profile before writing only an empty isolated staging directory
V4 profile fragments have bounded count and total bytes and preserve supported 128KiB avatars without changing frozen V1/V2/V3 frames
A single runtime-owned essential worker uses the shared adaptive control budget, retries transient failures promptly and resets cooldown on verified route or identity changes

escalation: Require real direct-pairing, private-record restart, unrelated-peer denial and native canonical logout/relogin evidence. Legacy CLI V1/V2/V3 remain compatible.

capability.summary: Pause optional third-party group attachment export on restricted or unknown host-observed networks without changing signed preferences, consent or retention.

invariants.name: Both sync directions and existing stores recheck file-only export; original sends and group text/control/offer recovery continue, and cached chunks survive pause/resume.
Cost-class changes expire session-local exceptions; manual share-off and conversation authorization remain authoritative.

escalation: Native cost signals and physical/VPN routes require platform acceptance separately; loopback policy tests do not establish hotspot classification or a zero-byte handoff guarantee.

capability.summary: Deliver immutable encrypted sticker media without requiring recipient pack installation and reuse verified transfer bytes only within the same conversation and deadline.

invariants.name: Pack installation and message media retention are independent; exact image identity is the authenticated attachment checksum
Canonical v1 sticker metadata remains readable; v2 carries a bounded safe label through encrypted delivery and retained history without changing authenticated image identity
Bounded canonical presentation metadata remains compatible ordinary media and never grants cross-conversation read access
A cached image only completes a new manifest after exact retained ancestry, origin binding and durable byte validation; cache presence alone never proves recipient delivery

Exact installed artwork can reconstruct authenticated original-author chunks from bounded optional headers; signature, checksum, retained manifest authorization and exact completion are unchanged. Missing or incompatible sources use ordinary byte transfer.

escalation: Run encrypted loopback delivery, source-removal/restart, same-host reuse and deadline/isolation regressions plus the sticker browser suite. Mocked browser results do not prove native decoder availability, deployed relay retention or linked-device policy.

capability.summary: Display OS hostnames only within the same account through encrypted certified-sibling device synchronization.

invariants.name: Hostnames never enter public discovery or peer profiles; unrelated Noise peers and stale native owner/account admissions cannot read them.
Bounded source-device metadata persists encrypted, supports offline display, rejects generic writes and preserves legacy synchronization through an independent cooldown.

capability.summary: Preserve a participant-consented original registration office across encrypted directory and federation hops without disclosing it by default.

invariants.name: Both signatures bind the exact participant and office; optional origin never establishes physical location or transport authority
Opt-out serializes with active sends and invalidates prepared work; original 15-second consent leases cannot be renewed by forwarding or presentation tolerance
Legacy discovery and mailbox wire layouts stay compatible and carry no optional origin disclosure

capability.summary: Keep authenticated working routes ahead of already known supplied endpoints while preserving fresh one-off precedence and signed port replacement.

invariants.name: A known stalled supplied route cannot consume the last outbound slot ahead of an authenticated preferred route; fresh unknown endpoints and signed port replacement retain their existing meaning.

escalation: Use the real loopback single-slot stalled-route regression and signed-port/fresh-endpoint tests; physical VM NAT discovery and native delivery remain separate environment acceptance.

capability.summary: Project one authenticated logical file message across per-device signed manifests while preserving exact consent/completion and intentional repeated sends.

invariants.name: Only a sender-signed binding of exact manifest IDs, source certificate, recipient account and manifest bytes establishes equivalence; artwork, transfer IDs and send time do not.
Canonical history identity and alias suppression survive private synchronization, deletion, recall and recovery; deployed manifest/account-card encodings and exact delivery receipts remain unchanged.

escalation: Run duplicate device fanout/sibling import, deliberate repeat, signed identity tampering, restart, recall/delete, relay-only and recovery snapshot regressions; test optional metadata fallback with older peers before merge.

capability.summary: Publish owner-authorized encrypted shared group photos and current announcements while preserving private photo overrides and independent field revisions.

invariants.name: Only the current accepted owner account publishes; former-owner forks cannot replace transferred metadata. Current field keys reach accepted new members through retained holders independently of pre-join message history, without sharing sender chains.
Announcement deletion tombstones and bounded group artwork survive replay; metadata event kind 19 requires appended V5 sync envelopes before transfer to older decoders.

escalation: Exercise real linked owner-account devices, removal/re-invitation, source-offline restart and mixed-version native clients. Loopback TCP tests establish encrypted event convergence but not physical LAN reachability.

capability.summary: Stage ordinary private and group attachment ciphertext in recipient-encrypted post-office custody before receiver approval, preserving exact recipient consent and verified completion.

invariants.name: Ciphertext custody may precede approval; recipient durable chunk admission and direct pushes still require approval. Only verified recipient completion retires delivery work.
Group controls remain bound to the exact retained offer, current signed membership and recipient device; group permission never grants private-DM access.
Refusal, removal, expiry, recall and runtime retirement stop further custody publication; bounded rotating jobs keep old controls from starving new work.
